title: Europe coverage evidence tranche 1C - Estonia, Latvia, Poland, Czech Republic, Greece

safety.message: This pack onboards current official sources and creates pending proposals only. Independent review, fresh monitoring, and human-published verified rules remain required.

references.evidence_summary: The Estonian Police and Border Guard Board operates politsei.ee/en as the official English-language portal covering migration and citizenship services.
The Latvian Office of Citizenship and Migration Affairs operates pmlp.gov.lv/en as the official English-language portal for citizenship and migration matters.
The Polish Office for Foreigners operates the gov.pl/udsc portal as the official source for foreigners in Poland.
The Ministry of the Interior of the Czech Republic operates mv.gov.cz/mvcren as the official English-language portal covering asylum, migration and Schengen matters.
The Greek Ministry of Migration and Asylum operates migration.gov.gr as the official portal for migration policy and asylum services.

batch.name: v10.22.16 Europe evidence tranche 1C - EE, LV, PL, CZ, GR
batch.notes: Official-source evidence for Estonia (EE), Latvia (LV), Poland (PL), Czech Republic (CZ) and Greece (GR). All five endpoints were locally probed from the API container and returned HTTPS 200 responses with usable migration, citizenship or asylum content. The tranche is intentionally limited to the narrow service functions described and does not claim complete immigration-law coverage. Submission creates pending proposals only; independent reviewer certification remains required.

immigration_assessment.evidence_title: Estonian Police and Border Guard Board official English portal
immigration_assessment.rationale: The Estonian Police and Border Guard Board operates politsei.ee/en as the official English-language portal covering migration and citizenship services. This supports a proposal that Estonia directly administers the relevant migration services through the Police and Border Guard Board.

source_onboarding.source_name: Estonian Police and Border Guard Board English portal
source_onboarding.evidence_notes: Locally probed on 2026-07-18 with status local_probe_passed. Keep the initial certification limited to the migration and citizenship services explicitly described.
